content.text: All tickets are strictly non-refundable and non-transferable.

As spaces are limited, your ticket acts a commitment to attend and helps ensure that spaces are available to the women who genuinely wish to join us. Please only purchase a ticket if you intend to come.
If your plans change because of unexpected circumstances, please let us know as soon as possible so we can offer your place to someone on the waitlist who'd like to be there.
Thank you for understanding and supporting our community.

In the event of heavy rain or unsafe weather conditions, events may be rescheduled. All tickets will remain valid for the new date. If you are unable to join on the new date, please let us know via email and we will arrange a credit for a future walk.
We aim to proceed as planned where possible. A final decision will be made at least 1 hour before the start time of the event and communicated via email and Happy Girl Movement’s Instagram stories.
